disposition: Three historical core-model overlaps remain resolved; new Q059 quantum cavity model screened against Q011/Q016/Q024/Q056/Q014, pending independent expert review. Draft 18/50.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: f-plane rotating shallow water with Coriolis-induced Poincare dispersion, geostrophic zero mode and coastal Kelvin localization
new_draft_model_screening.difference: W039 is parametric oscillator; W043 is background-current shallow water; W048 is gravity-capillary dispersion; W054 is bathymetry-step transmission. None has rotating geostrophic PV and coastal trapped Kelvin eigenmode.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: spatially varying optical director q-plate with spin-to-orbital Pancharatnam-Berry phase, angular momentum and mechanical torque
new_draft_model_screening.difference: O036/O051 concern uniform retarder Jones matrices; O044 is scalar sinusoidal phase grating; O020 is scalar Fourier diffraction. None addresses spatial half-integer director winding, helicity-flip OAM, q-dependent optical torque and analyzer petal topology.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: quantized Jaynes--Cummings cavity with excitation-number-resolved dressed doublets, Poissonian collapse/revival and dispersive atom-cavity conditional phase
new_draft_model_screening.difference: Q011/Q024/Q056 are semiclassically driven two-level Rabi models with a fixed coupling; Q016 treats a free oscillator coherent state; Q014 studies a frequency quench. None contains the quantized cavity square-root photon-number splitting, Poisson-weighted revival or dispersive cavity-state overlap.
